FN-LRNMAAA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 182
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Craig Lipscomb
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/27/2024
House Bill 182 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of local law
enforcement agencies to implement the provisions of this bill regarding removal of individuals
from certain places.
Page 1

FN-LRNMAAA-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 182
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Craig Lipscomb
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2024
House Bill 182 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase receipts to the State
General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General
Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are
deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, local jails, the district
attorneys, the Department of Corrections, the Board of Pardons and Paroles, and community
corrections programs by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons
charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of local law enforcement
agencies to implement the provisions of this bill regarding removal of individuals from certain
places, which could be offset, in whole or partly, by the increase in receipts to local law
enforcement agencies by the collection of a fee of up to $50 per affidavit processed pursuant to
the provisions of this bill.
